profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Informa
profile.summary: Experienced FullStack Web Developer with a demonstrated history of working with web applications / services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Development of Web Applications using C# .NET, Asp.NET MVC / Web Api with HTML5, Vue.js, Javascript, CSS (CSS3, Foundation, MDL), .NET(4.6), .NETCORE
* Sql Experience (Dapper, Postgresql, DataGrip)
* Use of TFS GIT based Team Solutions
* Work within an Agile Methodology (SCRUM)

positions.title: C# UI/UX Developer
positions.description:
*.NET Web Development utilizing MVC/WEBAPI architecture
*Sql Server / Sql Server Management Studio 2014
*Heavy Use of Angular (1.X), native Javascript
*Work within an Agile Methodology (Waterfall, KanBan) 
*TFS/Git Team Experience

positions.title: Junior .NET Developer
positions.description:
*Development of Web Applications using C# .NET, ASP.NET MVC with HTML5, Javascript (Angular, JQuery), web styling (CSS3, Bootstrap, LESS)
*Development of multiple large, corporate websites from start to finish
*Development of Angular FrontEnd Technology for mobile e-commerce application
*Work within an Agile Methodology (KanBan)
*Development work surrounding the CMS Sitefinity
*Direct CMS Configuration Handling of Sitefinity

positions.title: KCIT Apprentice - Security IT
positions.description:
*Development of .NET based solutions for Client Portal implementation and AD Audit Automation in both ASP.NET and Powershell, utilizing Microsoft AD Libraries
*Implementation of Automated Strategies targeting the Microsoft AD Environment using Powershell.
*Configuring of ASP.NET Web Applications with external APIs for autosync of client credentials. 
*Monitoring of AD Account changes over a large number of domains and sub-domains
*Oversaw auditing of multiple domains with use of Powershell.
